description: Main source file for eSPI driver sample on Zephyr RTOS, implementing eSPI communication, flash testing, and safety features.

methods.name: spi_saf_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI flash via SAF, sets QE bit if needed.

methods.name: espi_saf_init
methods.description: Configures eSPI SAF and sets protection regions.

methods.name: pr_check_range
methods.description: Checks if protection region range matches register values.

methods.name: pr_check_enable
methods.description: Checks if protection region enable status matches register values.

methods.name: pr_check_lock
methods.description: Checks if protection region lock status matches register values.

methods.name: pr_check_master_bm
methods.description: Checks master bitmaps for protection regions.

methods.name: espi_saf_test_pr1
methods.description: Tests SAF protection regions configuration.

methods.name: saf_read
methods.description: Reads data from SAF flash in chunks.

methods.name: saf_erase_block
methods.description: Erases SAF flash block with specified size.

methods.name: saf_page_prog
methods.description: Programs SAF flash page with data.

methods.name: espi_flash_test
methods.description: Performs write/read test on SAF flash.

methods.name: host_warn_handler
methods.description: Handles host warning virtual wire signals.

methods.name: espi_reset_handler
methods.description: Handles eSPI bus reset events.

methods.name: espi_ch_handler
methods.description: Handles eSPI channel ready events.

methods.name: vwire_handler
methods.description: Handles received eSPI virtual wires.

methods.name: periph_handler
methods.description: Handles eSPI peripheral notifications.

methods.name: espi_init
methods.description: Initializes eSPI configuration and callbacks.

methods.name: wait_for_pin
methods.description: Waits for a GPIO pin to reach a specific level with timeout.

methods.name: wait_for_vwire
methods.description: Waits for a specific virtual wire signal level with timeout.

methods.name: wait_for_espi_reset
methods.description: Waits for eSPI reset status to match expected.

methods.name: espi_handshake
methods.description: Performs handshake with eSPI master via virtual wires.

methods.name: read_test_block
methods.description: Reads a block of data from eSPI flash.

methods.name: write_test_block
methods.description: Writes a block of data to eSPI flash.

methods.name: espi_flash_test
methods.description: Performs write/read test on eSPI flash memory.

methods.name: espi_test
methods.description: Main test routine for eSPI communication, flash, and safety features.
